Buying a Property in Aura Gardens

Aura Gardens offers an exclusive collection of townhouses and villas for sale in Tilal Al Ghaf, presenting a unique opportunity for families seeking peaceful living in one of Dubai’s most prestigious communities. Prospective buyers can choose from elegantly designed 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses, as well as luxurious 4-bedroom villas, each crafted to meet the highest standards of comfort and style. The starting prices for these residences reflect their premium quality, with 3-bedroom townhouses available from AED AED 1.78M, 4-bedroom townhouses from AED 1.99M, and 4-bedroom twin villas starting at AED 2.94 M.

Buyers can secure their property with a 10% down payment, followed by 45% during the construction phase. Upon completion, an additional 5% will be required, while the remaining 40% can be settled over 24 months post-handover. 

This structured payment plan makes it convenient for investors and end-users alike to own villas or townhouses for sale in Tilal Al Ghaf ensuring a seamless and rewarding buying experience.
